comment: The w, x, y and z jacks and all three outputs carry whatever the script makes of them, so they are left without a family. Input index 0 is w, not the leftmost jack: the leftmost is t at index 4. Output index 0 is the bottom jack, out. The light enum is named the other way round from what it does: with the script compiled the module lights lights[ERROR_LIGHT], which is the green half of the two-colour lamp, and blinks lights[OK_LIGHT], the red half, when compilation fails.
